key_insight: The paper turns LWE cryptanalysis into a penalty-free QUBO by using the squared decoding error directly as the objective, enabling hybrid solving on a Coherent Ising Machine.
engineering_relevance: It proposes an algorithm-hardware co-design that reduces qubit usage and coefficient range, making a 40-dimensional LWE instance practical for NISQ-style hybrid execution.
method: Eliminate the LWE secret algebraically and embed the problem into a q-ary lattice/CVP formulation.
Map the squared error norm directly to QUBO energy without penalty terms.
Use CR-BNP with adaptive mixed-radix encoding to compress the hardware representation and support batched submission.
evidence_signal: The authors report an end-to-end demonstration on the TU Darmstadt LWE Challenge, including both Search- and Decision-LWE for a 40-dimensional instance on the CPQC-550 CIM.
watch_item: Performance may depend on encoding quality and hardware noise, so the claimed scaling and early-stopping threshold likely need careful validation beyond the demonstrated instance.
paper_title: When the Learning With Errors Problem Meets the Coherent Ising Machine: A Penalty-Free Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design
